Complete species listing

All taxa in the validated public archive, including hybrids. Photographs are currently available for Robin, Swallow, Mallard and Peregrine. Select a bird to open its factfile. Historical records count observation reports, not individual birds.

About locations and factfile coverage

“Latest public eBird report” means the latest dated public-hotspot report in our loaded borough and Wetland Centre feeds. It may be older or newer than the archive’s last recorded date. The feeds are incomplete; this is not necessarily the last sighting anywhere in the borough. Private locations and observer/checklist details are excluded.

Historical nicknames are taken from the supplied workbook and labelled as not independently source-checked. Biological facts retain their verification controls. Full listing coverage does not mean full photographic or factfile coverage. Missing values do not establish absence. Conservation labels name their UK assessment and are separate from borough reporting rank.
